Executive summary

This report consolidates 3 RUL experiment run(s) into one dissertation-style artefact. It combines aggregate metrics, model-level diagnostics, train/validation dynamics, held-out bearing predictions, residual analysis, execution logs, and full merged configuration for reproducibility.

  • Rank models by test behavior, not validation alone: validation RMSE selects checkpoints, but held-out bearing plots show whether that checkpoint generalizes.
  • Use multiple metrics: RMSE emphasizes large mistakes, MAE shows typical absolute error, R² shows explained variance, and PHM score captures the asymmetric cost profile used in bearing prognostics.
  • Check runtime and parameters: a lower RMSE is only compelling if its training time and model size are acceptable for the intended research comparison.

The ablation section is the report's high-level scoreboard. Results are aggregated across 3 run(s) by matching the stable run_id prefix before the seed suffix. That makes repeated seeds comparable without hiding model or dataset identity.

How to read this section. Each metric is plotted on its own axis so scale does not mislead the comparison. Error bars show seed-level standard deviation where repeated runs exist. Configuration

This merged YAML is the exact configuration used for the run: data setup, feature pipeline, model parameters, optimizer schedule, seed, and output paths.

data:
  dataset: cwru
  root: ../data-bearing/cwru
  cache_dir: ../data-bearing/processed/cwru
  window_length: 32
  stride_train: 2
  stride_eval: 16
  label_scheme: fault_severity
  smoothing_alpha: 0.05
  n_bands: 5
  batch_size: 512
  num_workers: 8
  train_bearings:
  - IR007_0_109
  - IR014_0_174
  - B007_0_122
  - B014_0_189
  - OR007_6_3_138
  - OR014_6_3_204
  - Time_Normal_0_097
  - Time_Normal_1_098
  val_bearings:
  - IR021_0_213
  - B021_0_226
  - OR021_6_3_241
  - Time_Normal_2_099
  test_bearings:
  - IR007_1_110
  - B007_1_123
  - OR007_6_0_135
  - Time_Normal_3_100
model:
  name: mamba_xlstm_net
  d_model: 128
  xlstm_blocks: 3
  slstm_positions:
  - 1
  xlstm_heads: 4
  xlstm_force_fallback: false
  mamba_blocks: 2
  mamba_d_state: 128
  mamba_d_conv: 4
  mamba_expand: 2
  mamba_headdim: 64
  mamba_n_groups: 1
  mamba_rope_fraction: 0.5
  mamba_is_mimo: false
  mamba_mimo_rank: 4
  mamba_chunk_size: 64
  mamba_is_outproj_norm: false
  mamba_bidirectional: true
  mamba_backend: auto
  fusion: gated
  head_hidden: 64
  dropout: 0.1
train:
  max_epochs: 75
  lr: 0.0008
  weight_decay: 0.0003
  xlstm_lr_mult: 0.75
  freeze_xlstm_epochs: 5
  scheduler: cosine
  warmup_epochs: 5
  monotonicity_weight: 0.05
  gradient_clip_val: 1.0
  early_stopping_patience: 9999
  precision: bf16-mixed
  seed: 42
  results_root: results
  run_id: null

Configuration

This merged YAML is the exact configuration used for the run: data setup, feature pipeline, model parameters, optimizer schedule, seed, and output paths.

data:
  dataset: cwru
  root: ../data-bearing/cwru
  cache_dir: ../data-bearing/processed/cwru
  window_length: 32
  stride_train: 2
  stride_eval: 16
  label_scheme: fault_severity
  smoothing_alpha: 0.05
  n_bands: 5
  batch_size: 512
  num_workers: 8
  train_bearings:
  - IR007_0_109
  - IR014_0_174
  - B007_0_122
  - B014_0_189
  - OR007_6_3_138
  - OR014_6_3_204
  - Time_Normal_0_097
  - Time_Normal_1_098
  val_bearings:
  - IR021_0_213
  - B021_0_226
  - OR021_6_3_241
  - Time_Normal_2_099
  test_bearings:
  - IR007_1_110
  - B007_1_123
  - OR007_6_0_135
  - Time_Normal_3_100
model:
  name: sparse_gate_tcn_rul
  model_specific_loss: true
  tcn_channels:
  - 64
  - 64
  - 128
  - 128
  tcn_kernel: 3
  gate_hidden: 32
  gate_context: 5
  attn_d_model: 32
  attn_heads: 4
  head_hidden: 64
  dropout: 0.1
  lambda_sparse: 0.001
  lambda_entropy: 0.001
train:
  model_specific_loss: true
  max_epochs: 75
  lr: 0.0008
  weight_decay: 0.0003
  xlstm_lr_mult: 0.75
  freeze_xlstm_epochs: 5
  scheduler: cosine
  warmup_epochs: 5
  monotonicity_weight: 0.05
  gradient_clip_val: 1.0
  early_stopping_patience: 9999
  precision: bf16-mixed
  seed: 42
  results_root: results
  run_id: null
